mapper.select: select clue.*, ctr.*, ctr.id ctr_id, ctr.user_id ctr_user_id, ctr.subject ctr_subject, ctr.level ctr_level, ctr.next_time ctr_next_time, ctr.create_time ctr_create_time, user.name as assignName from clue left join clue_track_record ctr on clue.id = ctr.clue_id left join user on ctr.user_id = user.id where clue.id = #{id}
